description: This is a PHP source code file defining a controller class for managing the 'tax' extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying and saving tax-related settings.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Controller class for the Tax total extension in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for rendering and saving tax configuration settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the tax extension settings page in the admin panel, including loading language, setting page title, preparing breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the tax extension settings, including permission checking, updating the settings, and returning a JSON response.
